title: rules.version.publish-requested.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where an author requests publication of a DRAFT version (POST .../versions/{v}:request-publish, DESIGN section 3.3). The version is now PENDING_APPROVAL and frozen. The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1.

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

occurredAt.description: When the transition committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

canonicalHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document, lower-case hex: the behaviour under four eyes (ADR-0026). effectiveFrom is not part of it.

requestedBy.description: Who requested publication; always equal to actor. The approver must be someone else.

effectiveFrom.description: The instant the version is asked to take effect, ISO 8601 UTC, or null for 'at approval'. Version metadata, outside canonicalHash.
